backup.heading: Data & Backup
backup.description: Export your data or review a file before merging it.
backup.scope: Includes bookmarks, folders, workspaces, saved sessions, notes, site searches, tabs, splits and preferences.
backup.exclusions: Excludes cookies, passwords, site permissions, history, recently closed tabs, downloads and signing keys.
backup.limit: Versioned .spark-backup.json files up to 32 MiB. Keep them somewhere you control.
backup.keep_current: Current tabs, selection and order will be preserved. Missing occurrences are appended as hibernated tabs.
backup.imported: Data imported. Current values were preserved in conflicts.
backup.pending: Backup preferences are pending. The imported data is already saved.
backup.error_stale: Data changed while reviewing. Refresh the preview before importing.
backup.error_invalid: The backup file is invalid or incompatible. No data was imported.
backup.error_large: The backup exceeds the 32 MiB limit.
backup.error_pending: Apply the pending preferences before importing another set of preferences.
backup.search_description: Export or merge a local backup.
backup.pref_site_zoom: Site zoom (local values win on conflicts)
backup.sync_description: Sync with Google Drive, your own folder or WebDAV, with no Spark servers.
backup.sync_gdrive_hint: Saves the file in Google Drive's Spark Backup folder using your signed-in account. No local folder or Google Cloud project required.
backup.sync_gdrive_account_sub: Choose which Gmail account to use or click Sync now to detect your signed-in Google Drive session.
backup.sync_auto_gdrive: Send every minute when changed and when closing the browser
backup.sync_auto_folder: Save on every change and when closing the browser
backup.sync_auto_webdav: Send every minute when changed and when closing the browser
backup.sync_direct_apply_prefs: Also apply preferences when using Direct Apply (Auto-Merge)
backup.sync_webdav_secret_saved: Saved secret active (leave blank to keep)
backup.sync_remember_secret: Remember password on this computer (uncheck to keep only for this session)
backup.sync_unchanged: Already up to date (no changes to send).
backup.error_sync_not_configured: Configure a sync folder or direct connection first.
backup.error_sync_folder_missing: The selected sync folder does not exist or is unavailable.
backup.error_sync_file_not_found: No browser.spark-backup.json file was found at the sync destination yet.
backup.error_sync_invalid_url: Enter a valid WebDAV URL without embedded credentials.
backup.error_sync_https_required: Direct cloud connections require an https:// URL.
backup.error_sync_auth_failed: Authentication with the direct connection server was rejected.
backup.error_sync_secure_storage_failed: Could not access secure credential storage. Unlock your system keyring, or enter the password and keep it only for this session. Linux requires secret-tool and a Secret Service provider.
backup.error_sync_network_failed: Could not reach the direct sync server.
backup.error_sync_gdrive_login_required: Sign in to your Google / Gmail account in a browser tab first so Spark can access your Google Drive session.
backup.local_description: Keep a rolling history of backups on this computer so you can go back to an earlier state.
backup.schedule_on_exit: Also back up when the browser closes
backup.manual_description: Save a backup file or restore from one.
backup.status_description: Overview of the automatic backups on this computer.
backup.schedule_description: When to back up and how many to keep.
backup.bookmarks_skipped: {count} left out because they are not http or https addresses.
backup.error_bookmarks_extension: Choose a file name ending in .html, .htm or .csv to match the format.
backup.error_bookmarks_empty: There are no bookmarks to export.
backup.schedule_retention_note: The newest backup is always kept. “Before replace” copies are kept separately: the 5 newest, for up to 30 days.
backup.safety_saved: A copy of your previous data was saved to the backup history before it was replaced.
backup.encrypt_description: Exports, history and sync files are encrypted with AES-256-GCM. The password stays in your system credential store. If you lose it, those backups cannot be recovered.
backup.encrypt_older_note: Older backups keep the password they were created with.
backup.unlock_description: This backup is encrypted. Enter its password to review it.
backup.error_password_required: This backup is encrypted and needs a password.
backup.error_password_wrong: The password is wrong, or the backup file was modified.
backup.error_password_invalid: Use a password with 8 to 256 characters.
backup.error_password_missing: Encryption is on but its password is unavailable. Unlock your system keyring or set the password again.
backup.error_crypto_failed: The backup could not be encrypted or decrypted.
backup.error_nothing_selected: Select at least one item to restore.
backup.error_checksum: The backup file is damaged or was edited after it was saved. No data was imported.
backup.error_newer_version: This backup was created by a newer version of Spark. Update the app to restore it.
backup.mode_replace_hint: Selected items are deleted and replaced by the backup. Workspaces, tabs and splits are always merged so open tabs are never closed.
backup.replace_warning: {count} current items will be permanently deleted and replaced.
backup.replace_workspaces_note: Workspaces, tabs and splits are merged, not replaced.
backup.nothing_selected: Select at least one item to restore.
